notes: The article on חָלָב is unrepresented because the ASV writes no *the* anywhere in the phrase, rendering it *a bottle of milk*; the supplied *a* belongs to the noun it stands before (rules 29, 15).
Both hiphils of שָׁקָה are light-verb renderings headed on the complement *drink* (rule 44), and נָא takes the whole formula *I pray thee* including its pronouns (rule 30).
